Glob.description: Relative path glob: `*` within a segment, `?` one character, `**` any segments.

Migration.description: A change to project code made when an update crosses `to`, shown in the plan like any other change.

ast_grep.description: An ast-grep rule file in the pack, e.g. `migrations/2.0.0.yml`; needs the `ast-grep` program.

description.description: What it changes, for the plan.

files.description: Project files it runs on; they must also be in `permissions.write`.

rename.description: Renames an identifier, matching whole words only.

to.description: Runs when updating from a version below this one to this one or later.

oneOf.description: User interface code, such as components, screens and their styles, on any platform.
Server code, such as HTTP routes, middleware, errors and database access.
Code for phone and tablet apps, e.g. with Swift, Flutter or Jetpack Compose.
Code for desktop apps on Windows, macOS or Linux, e.g. with Flutter, Compose Multiplatform or Dioxus.

PackTranslation.description: A pack's text in one locale.

description.description: The pack's `description` in this locale; the pack must have a `description`.

Permissions.description: What a pack may do; granted by the user on install.

commands.description: External commands the pack may run.

dependencies.description: Whether the pack may add dependencies.

write.description: Paths the pack may create or modify.

description: `pack.toml`: a pack's name, version and permissions.

kinds.description:
What the pack is for, as many as apply: `ui`, `backend`, `mobile` or `desktop`, each once, e.g.
`["ui", "mobile"]`. The pack directory lists the pack under each kind.

migrations.description: Code changes applied when an update crosses a version.

name.description: Lowercase letters, digits and `-`, starting with a letter.

permissions.description: What the pack may do in a project.

translations.description:
The pack's text in other languages, by locale, e.g. `[translations.es-mx]`. Readers in that locale see it,
and the English text where it gives none.

title: PackManifest
